nodes.name: PW-Ni4 synthesis
nodes.procedure: 17.81 g Na2WO4·2H2O, 1.61 g Na2HPO4·7H2O and 3.48 g Ni(NO3)2·6H2O were dissolved into 50 ml of deionized water in a beaker by adjusting the pH to 7.0 with hydrochloric acid, then the obtained pale green suspension was refluxed for 2 h at 100 °C. After removing the precipitate by filtering, 20 g NaCl was added to the reflux solution for crystallization.

nodes.name: TBA-PW9-Ni4 synthesis
nodes.procedure: Firstly, 5 g tetrabutylammonium bromide (TBABr) were dissolved into 10 ml 0.5 M sodium acetate buffer (pH = 4.6) as solution A. Take 40 ml of the supernatant obtained in step (a) as solution B. Then, solution A was slowly added into solution B under magnetic stirring. The resulting yellow precipitate was collected by centrifugation and washed twice with deionized water and ethanol respectively. The final products were obtained by drying at the temperature of 60 °C for 12 h.

nodes.name: MOF@POM solvothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 135.8 mg FeCl3·6H2O, 118.9 mg CoCl2·6H2O and 150 mg TBA-PW9-Ni4 were added to a mixed solution of DMF (17.5 ml), deionized water (1.25 ml) and anhydrous ethanol (1.25 ml). The obtained mixture was stirred for 1 h to form a dark-green solution and then 250 mg 1,4-BDC was added by stirring for 0.5 h. Thereafter, the solution was transferred into a 25 ml Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave and was heated to 125 °C for 12 h before it was cooled to room temperature. The product was obtained by washing with ethanol and deionized water three times, respectively and then dried at room temperature for 12 h.

nodes.name: CoFe-LDHs synthesis
nodes.procedure: 30 mL DMF was added into a Teflon liner (50 mL) containing H4DOT (0.090 g), Fe(ac)2 (0.047 g), Co(NO3)2·6H2O (0.210 g) to mix evenly, and then the 2×3 cm² NF after treatment was vertically dipped into the solution. The mixed reactor was reacted in the oven at 120 °C for 24 h. After the reaction, the solution was cooled to room temperature, the surface of the nickel foam was carefully washed with anhydrous ethanol and then placed in 60 °C vacuum drying for 6 h to obtain CoFe-LDHs.

nodes.name: NiFe-LDHs synthesis
nodes.procedure: Iron foam (1 cm × 3 cm) were washed with acetone and ethanol several times to clean their surfaces for further use. For the preparation of corrosive solution, a certain amount of nickel salts (NiSO4·6H2O; 100 μmol) was added into 100 mL deionized water to make a transparent Ni²⁺ solution in a conical flask. And then the iron substrates were immersed in the corrosive solution at room temperature (~25 °C) for 12 h. Then, wash the iron foam with deionized water and dry at 60 °C for 12 h.

nodes.name: Pt/C cathode preparation
nodes.procedure: A 20% Pt/C composition served as the cathode for the anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer, engaging a meticulously prepared blend of Pt/C, an ionic membrane solution, water, and isopropyl alcohol as the cathode ink, boasting a 2 wt% solid content that incorporates both the Pt/C catalyst and the ionic membrane. This cathode ink was meticulously dispersed onto the carbon paper's surface employing a spray-coater. The precise electrode loading on the cathode was determined through a comparative analysis of the carbon paper's mass before and after the application process, revealing a consistent loading of 1.0±0.1 mg cm⁻², inclusive of ionic membrane component.
